profile.headline: Web Developer, National Senior Manager at American Lung Association
profile.summary:
Building and creating drives me forward, whether it is websites, music, or bicycles.
As a full-stack web developer, I apply my creative and mechanical talent by developing websites that are fluid, well-managed, and empower the user. 
I'm an expert in breaking down complicated ideas and constructing them into something efficient and enjoyable.

Skills
•	HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Less, JavaScript, jQuery, React, Vue
•	Python
•	NodeJS, Express

positions.title: Web Developer, Specialist
positions.description:
JavaScript driven applications
Multiple API integration
JSON and XML feeds to dynamically generate content
UI Development from provided wireframes
UX contribution
AWS, Node.JS
Github

positions.title: Web Development Immersive Student
positions.description:
WDI: Web Development Immersive
Intensive course that builds fluency in full stack web development.

Topics Covered:
- Computer science theory, including data structures and algorithms
- Best practices for front and back-end web development
- Workflow best practices, including Command Line and Git/GitHub
- Test-driven development with Mocha, Chai, and RSpec
- CRUD and RESTful resources
- Authentication and authorization

Languages: JavaScript, Ruby, HTML, CSS
Frameworks: Node.js, ExpressJS, Rails, AngularJS
Database Tools: SQL, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, ActiveRecord
Other: Heroku, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, Bootstrap

positions.title: Technician and Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Analyzed complex mechanical issues to ensure safety and quality of products, resulting in zero liability and maintaining integrity of service for the company
•	Developed alternative repair options utilizing cost and profit analysis, while optimizing best outcome for the customer, leading to higher profitability
•	Marketed company products and services to potential customers, explaining in detail the necessary product/service mix/cost, while persuading premium services to increase revenue
•	Constructed an organized scheduling system subsequently improving operational pipeline, increasing volume of clientele, and leading to higher revenue

positions.title: Keyholder
positions.description:
Headed marketing efforts for retail location by managing social media, event planning
Maintained correspondence with business partners to coordinate cross promotion
Forecasted metrics including AOV, traffic, social media impact, cost/profit, and ROI
Set up and maintained various IT elements in store, including POS, Cisco VoIP, internet, printers, audio, Windows8 Customization, and provided assistance to staff with Google suite
Maintained fleet of bike-share rentals: Regular adjustment and repair
Maintained and organized inventory of supplies from Quality Bicycle Products
Contributed to the highest retail conversion rate in the company through in-store, telephone, and online sales
Organized and maintained logistics, inventory, shipping and receiving, general building maintenance

positions.title: Marketing and Communications Intern
positions.description:
Liaison with web developer, director, and community for designation of new site features and categorization
Organized website features geared specifically for local, online, niche community
Assisted with account management for marketing and promotion
Managed and reorganized online ad server via AdButler
Raised $8000 in merchandise sale of Chainlink products
Assisted with sponsored fund-raising event

positions.title: Writer
positions.description:
Authored articles requiring very specific guidelines and strict adherence to AP style grammar on a freelance basis for various clients.
Achieved “Top-Tier Writer” status through advanced testing and approval from professional editors

positions.title: Studio Musician
positions.description:
Recruited as a cellist to write and arrange music for various bands.

Recorded at JBTV and Flat Black Studios.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Front and Back End Web Development

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisted in Walk-In Bike-Out program, donating bicycles at no cost to the local community in line with Global Youth Service Day
Repaired and maintained bicycles in workshop
Worked with bike recipients to find best bike for their needs
Recruited volunteers and delegated tasks
Assisted in collection of bicycle donations from the City of Bloomington, Town of Normal, and other sources
